title: Act: Add contribution handlers, config and route wiring
summary: POST/GET contribution routes and player history are served; routes and config are wired.
description: Context: server.go registers only session routes. Desired behavior: handlers for POST /api/v1/contributions, GET /api/v1/contributions/{id}, GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions identify the player from the session cookie, map service errors to HTTP statuses, and server.New wires all routes with storage and contribution limits from YAML config. Expected result: endpoints work end to end in-process. Why: expose the feature.
acceptance_criteria: Given no valid session cookie, when POST /api/v1/contributions runs, then 401 is returned
Given a valid cookie and valid body {world_id, prompt}, when POST runs, then 201 with the contribution JSON is returned
Given ErrPromptLength/ErrRoundNotOpen/ErrLimitReached/ErrRateLimited/ErrDuplicate, when POST runs, then the status is 400/409/429/429/409 respectively and ErrWorldNotFound gives 404

in_scope: POST/GET contribution routes and player history are served; routes and config are wired.
preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Product code compiles with go build ./...

steps.action: Create Handler{Service *Service; Store Reader (Get(id) (Contribution, error); ListByPlayer(playerID string) ([]Contribution, error)); Secret []byte; CookieName string; TTL time.Duration; Now func() time.Time}. A playerID(r) helper reads the cookie and calls player.Verify. Create decodes {world_id, prompt}, calls Service.Submit and maps errors: ErrPromptLength 400, ErrWorldNotFound 404, ErrRoundNotOpen 409, ErrDuplicate/ErrSpam 409, ErrLimitReached/ErrRateLimited 429. Get and Mine return JSON; Get returns 404 when not found.
steps.expected: Handlers respond with the specified statuses

steps.action: Add fields Storage StorageConfig{RepoPath, ContentDir string} (yaml storage.repo_path, storage.content_dir) and Contribution ContributionConfig{MinPromptLen, MaxPromptLen, MaxPerPlayer, RateMax int; RateWindow time.Duration}; in LoadFS default RepoPath ".", ContentDir "game/content", MinPromptLen 3, MaxPromptLen 500, MaxPerPlayer 5, RateMax 3, RateWindow 1m.

After the player routes, build world.Repo{Root: cfg.Storage.RepoPath, ContentDir: cfg.Storage.ContentDir}, gitrepo.CLI{Dir, BotName: cfg.Git.BotName, BotEmail: cfg.Git.BotEmail}, contribution.FileStore, a RoundSource adapter over world.Repo.CurrentRound, contribution.Service with Limits from cfg.Contribution and Now time.Now, and register r.Get "/api/v1/worlds", "/api/v1/worlds/{id}", "/api/v1/worlds/{id}/game", "/api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current", r.Post "/api/v1/contributions", r.Get "/api/v1/contributions/{id}" and "/api/v1/player/me/contributions".
Append storage: {repo_path: ".", content_dir: "game/content"} and a contribution block with min_prompt_len 3, max_prompt_len 500, max_per_player 5, rate_max 3, rate_window "1m".
